author: seeingterra
label: Agentic Sims
description: Talk with your Sims from The Sims 4 in Voxta. Agentic Sims is a free mod and companion app that lets you chat with your Sims in real time, in the game. This module brings the Sims you choose into your Voxta chats too: ask how they're doing (mood, needs, relationships, what they're up to) and suggest what they do next, which you approve in Agentic Sims. Adds a Play card that opens Agentic Sims. Requires the Agentic Sims app (free download) and The Sims 4 on this Windows PC. Experimental: use a spare save.
